value.rationale: A natural complete phase diagram for nonlinear composition–differentiation on coefficient Dirichlet spaces. It resolves a nontrivial boundary issue: coefficients with identical magnitudes but different residue locations have sharply different closed-range behavior, undetected by boundedness/compactness or Hilbert–Schmidt criteria. Includes exact critical essential spectrum and all-p Schatten cutoff, without separately claiming the known abstract exponents.
